cases.name: etaf-posframe-rejects-invalid-options
cases.purpose: Unknown options, non-positive sizes, unsupported dismissal and anchors signal etaf-posframe-error with the offending option named.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-theme-returns-frame-colors
cases.purpose: A panel Theme derives every catalog token as an #RRGGBB color from the current frame.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-live-p-rejects-non-panels
cases.purpose: Lifecycle predicates accept only live panel objects and an empty panel list reports no panels.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-show-owns-panel-lifecycle
cases.purpose: Showing a View mounts one panel and hiding it releases the panel, its Runtime and its frame.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-toggle-hides-the-open-panel
cases.purpose: The toggle entry hides the current buffer's open panel instead of stacking a second one.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-show-replaces-the-buffer-panel
cases.purpose: A second show for the same buffer replaces the earlier panel instead of stacking two.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-pinned-theme-reaches-the-content
cases.purpose: A pinned :theme starts a content that owns its palette in that mode, and the content's later choice is not overridden.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-resize-follows-an-outside-resize-by-default
cases.purpose: A panel adopts a frame the user or a caller resized, which is what :resizable t means.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-resizable-nil-refuses-an-outside-resize
cases.purpose: `:resizable nil' puts the frame back to the size the panel allows after an outside resize.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-a-narrower-frame-clips-instead-of-wrapping
cases.purpose: A narrower frame keeps each canvas row on one line, so a panel clips what it cannot show instead of wrapping it.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-resizable-list-limits-the-axes
cases.purpose: A :resizable side list accepts the axes it names and restores the others.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-timeout-closes-the-panel
cases.purpose: A panel with :timeout hides by itself and releases its Runtime.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-focusable-panel-takes-and-restores-focus
cases.purpose: A focusable panel selects itself on open and returns focus to the previous frame on hide.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-killing-the-parent-buffer-closes-the-panel
cases.purpose: The panel owns a kill-buffer hook in its parent buffer, so killing that buffer releases the panel.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-frame-is-as-wide-as-the-canvas
cases.purpose: A panel frame is exactly as wide as its content columns, so no empty frame is left beside the canvas.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-frame-is-not-taller-than-the-content
cases.purpose: A one-line panel fits its frame and leaves no empty rows below the rendered content.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-header-bar-paints-the-full-width
cases.purpose: The title bar covers every panel column and keeps the panel's own palette in a theme whose header line is inverted.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-frame-follows-an-outside-resize
cases.purpose: A frame resized from outside becomes the panel width: the canvas and the title bar re-lay out at it and a later re-fit keeps it.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-frame-adopts-a-shorter-height
cases.purpose: A frame shortened below the rendered content becomes the new row budget, so a panel clips instead of growing back.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-panel-prints-without-recursing
cases.purpose: Printing a returned panel terminates, so evaluating an etaf-posframe-show call in a buffer cannot loop until memory runs out.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-panels-coexist-by-key
cases.purpose: Two panels with different keys stay open at the same time and hiding one leaves the other alive.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-show-replaces-the-same-key
cases.purpose: Showing a view again under the same key replaces only that panel, not the panels of other keys.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-toggle-targets-its-key
cases.purpose: Toggle hides the panel of its own key and leaves the panels of other keys open.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-anchors-place-panels-in-the-grid
cases.purpose: Frame and window anchors place a panel at the named corner, edge centre or centre of their rectangle.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-cell-places-a-panel-at-character-cells
cases.purpose: A :cell pair places the panel at the same character cell regardless of the panel size.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-rejects-a-bad-placement
cases.purpose: A placement that is not an anchor, a tagged pair or a function signals etaf-posframe-error naming the option.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-panel-opened-in-a-panel-is-independent
cases.purpose: A panel shown while another panel has focus belongs to the underlying buffer and survives that first panel.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-hiding-a-focused-panel-returns-focus
cases.purpose: Hiding a focused panel selects the frame it came from and a panel can be opened again immediately.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-stacks-panels-at-the-same-anchor
cases.purpose: Panels shown at one anchored place are stacked a gap apart at the same x, down to the last opened.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-stacks-a-tall-panel-against-a-short-one
cases.purpose: A panel taller than the one above it takes the next row of the stack instead of stepping by its own height and leaving a hole.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-draws-a-theme-bordered-panel
cases.purpose: A panel paints the requested border colour outside its text area, so the content keeps its exact width.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-rejects-stack-without-an-anchor
cases.purpose: :stack with a cell or a pixel position signals etaf-posframe-error instead of silently ignoring it.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-registered-apps-open-with-one-call
cases.purpose: Two registered applications open in their own panels with one call each, keep their shortcut keys and close independently.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-cycle-walks-panels-and-back
cases.purpose: Cycling moves focus through the open panels in order and returns to the frame behind them.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-focus-shows-in-the-border
cases.purpose: The panel holding the input focus paints its border in the theme accent while the others keep the resting border colour.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-fill-keeps-the-row-budget
cases.purpose: A panel with :fill keeps the row budget it asked for although its content is shorter.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-height-fits-the-parent-frame
cases.purpose: A row budget taller than the parent frame is clamped so the panel stays on screen.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-anchor-offset-shifts-the-anchor
cases.purpose: An (ANCHOR ROWS COLS) placement shifts the panel by exactly its character offset.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-hover-focuses-a-panel
cases.purpose: A focusable panel under the mouse pointer takes the input focus on its own.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-hides-panels-while-emacs-is-inactive
cases.purpose: While Emacs has no focused frame the panels are invisible, and they reappear when Emacs is active again.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-hover-paints-a-border-without-focus
cases.purpose: A pointer over a panel paints its border in the hover colour while the keyboard stays where it was, and leaving restores it.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-click-selects-a-panel
cases.purpose: A mouse button anywhere in a panel raises it and gives it the keyboard, while a passive panel never takes the focus from a click.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-theme-pins-a-mode
cases.purpose: A Theme pinned to light or dark keeps that palette when the Emacs frame mode changes.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-hover-is-dimmer-than-focus
cases.purpose: A hovered border takes half the accent while the focused border paints it fully.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-provides-the-panel-appearance
cases.purpose: A View inside a panel reads the panel's light or dark appearance through etaf-appearance.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-fraction-size-follows-the-frame
cases.purpose: A (fraction 0.5) width takes about half of the parent frame's pixel width.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-focus-on-open-controls-the-first-selection
cases.purpose: A focusable panel selects itself on open only when :focus-on-open asks.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-keep-alive-resumes-the-session
cases.purpose: A :keep-alive app hides and resumes the same session, and quitting calls :on-stop once.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-pointer-leaving-keeps-the-focus-border
cases.purpose: Moving the pointer off a focused panel keeps the panel selected and its focused border.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-theme-answers-for-its-own-frame
cases.purpose: A frame's palette follows that frame, even while another frame, such as a focused panel, holds the keyboard.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-theme-switch-lands-in-one-pass
cases.purpose: A theme switch repaints a focused panel and its title bar from the parent frame's new palette in one pass.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-title-bar-toggles-theme-mode
cases.purpose: A title-bar segment click repaints the panel on that mode without changing the Emacs themes, and the selected segment takes no hover face.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-title-bar-and-the-application-share-one-theme-state
cases.purpose: A panel whose content declared its surface paints the content's palette and offers its modes, so the application's own switch repaints the panel and a title-bar click writes the application's mode cell.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-tty-shows-a-panel-in-cells
cases.purpose: A terminal panel keeps its column width and content rows on screen, and its buffer holds the rendered View.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-tty-fill-keeps-the-row-budget
cases.purpose: A terminal panel keeps the row budget it asked for, so a terminal's one-pixel cells do not cap it at a small frame.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-tty-title-adds-only-the-header
cases.purpose: A titled terminal panel is its header plus its content rows, with no empty row below the content.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-tty-stack-leaves-one-cell
cases.purpose: Terminal panels stacked at one anchor stay one cell apart and share the same column.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-tty-anchors-keep-the-border-on-screen
cases.purpose: Every frame anchor keeps a terminal panel and its border cell inside the terminal.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-tty-refit-keeps-a-panel-inside
cases.purpose: Re-placing a terminal panel after a terminal resize leaves the panel and its border on screen.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-tty-hide-releases-the-frame
cases.purpose: Hiding a terminal panel deletes its frame and releases its Runtime.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-tty-move-keeps-the-place
cases.purpose: Moving a terminal panel keeps its new place through a refresh.
